$comment: Open(code)Share plugin config. Priority: OPENSHARE_* env vars > plugin options > this file > code defaults. Sync cadence keys are clamped into the worker's policy window (see worker SOCKET_POLICY/DEBOUNCE_MIN_MS/DEBOUNCE_MAX_MS/COMPLETED_DELAY_MAX_MS). Keys: workerUrl (your openshare-worker deployment; empty = plugin stays disabled), createToken (legacy: the worker's CREATE_TOKEN — keep OUT of git), servers (multi-server memberships: url -> {token, code, label, active, adminToken (root token for the TUI admin console)}; the active entry (or the first) receives new sessions; with no token the plugin ENROLLS itself — public servers take anyone, private ones need a code from the hoster; enrolled tokens persist to ~/.config/opencode/openshare.config.json), debounceMs (sync interval: max time between syncs while streaming; default 10000), completedDelayMs (idle this long before the share says completed; default 5000, 0 = immediate), modelLabel ($Provider/$Model placeholders; literal text sends as-is; empty string hides the model), ttlDays (per-share TTL, capped by the worker), authLogin/authPassword (optional read gate on the share pages; sent on create AND resume; empty on resume removes protection), spoolDir (temporary unacked-frame buffer; default XDG data home), urlFile (write each share URL to this file; empty = default openshare.urls.txt in the session's directory; "none" = no URL file), announceStderr (false silences the [openshare] live: / url file: log lines; the share itself is unaffected).
